info.name: WAB Merchant API
info.description: Generated by `npm run docs`. Do not edit by hand.

item.name: Auth
Send an OTP code on WhatsApp

request.description: Public. The platform limits run first (5 requests / 5 min, resend after 60 s, 15 min block); then the server sends a new code on WhatsApp in the `Accept-Language` language (ar default). A blocked phone or a running resend countdown answers 200 with `allowed: false` and sends nothing. A number WhatsApp cannot reach (not on WhatsApp) answers 422 `OTP_DELIVERY_FAILED` (the request still counts). A WhatsApp outage answers 503 `INTERNAL`.

item.name: Check the typed code and get an otpToken

request.description: Public. The right code (for this phone and purpose) is used up and answers `otpToken`. Errors: 401 `OTP_INVALID` (wrong code; `details[0].message` says how many attempts are left; the 5th wrong code blocks), 401 `OTP_EXPIRED` (no code, expired or already used: request a new one), 429 `OTP_BLOCKED` (blocked for 15 min).

item.name: Check a number before sending the OTP

request.description: 404 `PHONE_NOT_REGISTERED` when the number is not linked to a salon (the app offers to register one); 403 `MEMBER_INACTIVE` when the owner removed the member.

item.name: Log in with an otpToken

request.description: `otpToken` = the single-use proof from `POST /auth/otp/verify` (purpose LOGIN) for this phone. Errors: `OTP_INVALID`, `OTP_EXPIRED` (401), `OTP_BLOCKED` (429), `MEMBER_INACTIVE` (403), `PHONE_NOT_REGISTERED` (404). The profile carries role, salon and permissions for the app to cache.

item.name: Rotate the refresh token

request.description: Returns a new token pair and the current profile. Reusing an old refresh token ends every session of that login (401). A removed member gets 403 `MEMBER_INACTIVE` and all sessions end.

item.name: Log out

request.description: Revokes the refresh token and unlinks the device. Always succeeds for well-formed tokens.

item.name: Installations
Register or update this device

request.description: Firebase app-instance id, FCM token and versions. Links the device to the signed-in member so the salon's booking requests reach it.

item.name: Turn push notifications on or off

request.description: The member’s switch (M25). Off means no push is sent (booking requests too), but notifications still appear in the in-app list.

item.name: App config
Version policy, maintenance, OTP and discovery settings

request.description: Public. Called at launch with the installed version: tells the app whether it must or may update, whether maintenance is on, plus OTP length/resend and the nearby radius.

Bookings
Approve a pending booking (staff are re-checked: 409 SLOT_TAKEN if no longer free)

request.description: Needs the BOOKINGS_RESPOND permission (owner always). A booking that already left the expected status answers 422 ALREADY_HANDLED; a move the state machine forbids answers 422 INVALID_TRANSITION.

item.name: Reject a pending booking (reason code required)

request.description: Needs the BOOKINGS_RESPOND permission (owner always). A booking that already left the expected status answers 422 ALREADY_HANDLED; a move the state machine forbids answers 422 INVALID_TRANSITION.

item.name: Mark an approved booking completed (not before its start time)

request.description: Needs the BOOKINGS_OPERATE permission (owner always). A booking that already left the expected status answers 422 ALREADY_HANDLED; a move the state machine forbids answers 422 INVALID_TRANSITION.

item.name: Mark an approved booking as a no-show (not before its start time)

request.description: Needs the BOOKINGS_OPERATE permission (owner always). A booking that already left the expected status answers 422 ALREADY_HANDLED; a move the state machine forbids answers 422 INVALID_TRANSITION.

item.name: Cancel an approved booking before its start time (reason code required)

request.description: Needs the BOOKINGS_OPERATE permission (owner always). A booking that already left the expected status answers 422 ALREADY_HANDLED; a move the state machine forbids answers 422 INVALID_TRANSITION.

item.name: Move one person of an approved booking to another staff member

request.description: Needs BOOKINGS_OPERATE. The new staff member must pass the availability rules for that person (skills, bride qualification, working day, leave) and be free for the whole duration: 422 `STAFF_NOT_ELIGIBLE` / `SLOT_UNAVAILABLE`, 409 `SLOT_TAKEN`. Only approved bookings that have not started (422 `INVALID_TRANSITION`).

item.name: Staff who could take over one person of an approved booking right now (BOOKINGS_OPERATE; within the booking’s branch). Advisory: reassign re-checks under the lock.
Cancel the bookings a schedule, closure, leave or staff change would break (the ids come from the 409 SCHEDULE_CONFLICT)

request.description: Pending bookings are rejected and approved ones cancelled by the salon, with the given reason; full refunds follow. Needs BOOKINGS_RESPOND (pending) and BOOKINGS_OPERATE (approved). The answer lists each booking: `DONE` with its new status, or `FAILED` with the domain error code (e.g. already started); one failure never stops the others. Then repeat the original change. To reassign instead, use the reassign endpoint per booking.

item.name: Salon bookings by tab (pending, upcoming, today, past) with search and filters. BOOKINGS_VIEW_OWN sees only bookings assigned to the caller.

Payout details
The salon’s bank details, masked (owner only; null when none saved)
Save the bank details (owner only; needs a fresh OTP, purpose BANK_DETAILS)

request.description: The IBAN is validated (ISO 13616 checksum; Jordan = 30 characters) and stored encrypted (AES-256-GCM). `otpToken` = the single-use proof from `POST /auth/otp/verify` (purpose BANK_DETAILS, the owner’s own phone). A wrong, reused or expired proof is 401 `OTP_INVALID` / `OTP_EXPIRED`; a blocked number 429 `OTP_BLOCKED`; a manager is 403 `OWNER_REQUIRED`.
